title: Log Cabin Retreat minutes from Downtown Nashville
description:
Newly Re-modeled Log Cabin in the beautiful hills of North Nashville.   Just 15 minutes from the honky tonks on Broadway, The Grand Ole Opry, and the Opry Mills Mall.  Also located less than a mile from the Fontanel that has Ziplines and trail to walk.

The space
The cabin is located on 27 acres and offers amazing privacy.  2 bedroom/2 bath with a spacious living room, dining room, and kitchen area.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home.  There is plenty of room of private parking.
